entries.name: xray-core
entries.notes: Merge stable upstream into the N2X fork before changing this exact replacement; retain ArtX, AnyTLS, per-listener fallback and TLS bridge compatibility. Retain the pinned REALITY compatibility copy and cross-client Vision/HTTPS regressions; an explicit zero version floor must permit authenticated X25519-only fingerprints. CVE-2026-98432 mitigation disables implicit MPTCP while preserving explicit opt-in and existing fork extensions. Preserve AnyTLS reusable sessions when late data arrives for closed streams; outbound write errors must close only the affected stream.

entries.name: sing-box
entries.notes: Manual stable merge required before repinning. Preserve Scope lifecycle, dynamic users, AnyTLS cleanup, Naive browser proxy and per-node sniff/resolve. Compatibility copy origins are recorded in the fork. CVE-2026-98432 mitigation disables implicit MPTCP while preserving explicit opt-in and existing fork extensions. TUIC pre-read payloads use owned buffers with synchronized Read/Close state; preserve revocation and active-user wire compatibility.

local_sync.integration: Published module replacements; optional local go.work for development
local_sync.published_pins: Core commits pushed and resolved through the public Go module proxy/checksum workflow. CI, Docker and release builds use GOWORK=off.

xray_core.action: Use one allocation for the header and payload of each ArtX downlink DATA frame.

sing_box.action: stable v1.14.4 with dynamic lifecycle, Naive browser/native paths and synchronized shared AnyTLS stream closure; CVE-2026-98432 default MPTCP mitigation; synchronize TUIC pre-read buffer ownership and connection revocation without changing the wire format

security_patch.strategy: Backport listener-default mitigation to existing custom forks; patched host kernel remains required.
